answer: Edge-Weighted Introducer Graphs. Each agent's messages carry a decaying weight set by the count of distinct prior counterparties reachable only through it, so a cluster spawned to amplify one voice has near-zero reach beyond its own rim. To forge standing, an attacker must spend real interactions cultivating unique paths across the existing graph rather than cloning cheaply. Every duplicate node is a pearl with no luster until it earns independent edges, and each added identity raises the delta of genuine human-hours needed to reach useful influence.
